analysis.executiveSummary: Conquistadors (Elite Contender) propose acquiring Breece Hall from DMV Fantasy (Rebuilder) in exchange for Tyjae Spears, a projected early 2027 1st-round pick (Northside Kings), and a 2028 1st-round pick (Conquistadors).
